text:
Alex Chen: Hey team, first-day question — I only see a 'Sandbox key' in the console. Where's the hosted API key? :wave:
OnboardingBot: Welcome Alex! See onboarding doc: https://internal.redwood.ai/onboarding/new-hire-keys (also check Console > Settings > API keys)
Maria Alvarez: Hi Alex — welcome! Sandbox keys are auto-provisioned for dev. Hosted (production) keys require a request (security + billing). For quick testing you can use sandbox but be mindful of quotas and rate-limits.
Alex Chen: Thanks — what are the sandbox limits? I'm planning to run a small latency test with streaming.
Samir Patel: Sandbox is pretty low‑priority. Typical limits: short burst allowed, but sustained throughput is throttled. For streaming tests you'll hit token/stream concurrency. If you need stable perf, request a hosted key.
Jordan Li: To request hosted access: 1) Fill out the hosted-api request form https://redwood.ai/internal/hosted-key-request 2) Add expected QPS, model(s), data sensitivity, and contact. 3) CC your manager. Ops approves within 24–48h.
Alex Chen: Sweet — what exact info should I include in the request? Any template? :thinking_face:
Maria Alvarez: Paste this in the form or ticket:

```
Project: Search Relevance POC
Team: Search Platform
Expected QPS: 50
Peak concurrency: 8
Models: redwood-v1-small (text-gen)
Use-case: inference tests, non-PII
Requested start: 2026-04-01
Contact: alex.chen@redwood.ai
```

That helps infra size capacity and pick a quota profile.
Samir Patel: Also mention if you need longer context windows or streaming; those affect kernel selection.
Alex Chen: If approved, will I get a long-lived token? How do we avoid committing keys to git?
Jordan Li: You'll get a hosted API key tied to the org project. Best practice: store in Vault or our secrets service (docs: https://internal.redwood.ai/secrets). Don't paste keys in public channels. Use `redwood-cli login --token` locally or set REDWOOD_API_KEY in CI/CD secret.
OnboardingBot: Reminder — production keys are audited. Access requests create an audit ticket.
Alex Chen: If I hit a quota, who do I ping? #eng-platform or infra@redwood.ai?
Maria Alvarez: Ping #eng-platform for quick triage. For increases include the request form link you submitted. Tag @Samir or @Jordan if it's high-priority.
Samir Patel: If you need temporary extra quota for experiments, we can enable a short-lived boost (include timeframe). For anything permanent, submit the form and we'll update the quota profile.
Alex Chen: Amazing — thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
Maria Alvarez: Welcome aboard — excited to have you. If you want a quick 1:1 on perf testing, DM me.
Jordan Li: Happy to pair on the first hosted request.
Alex Chen: Will do. Closing this thread after I submit the form.
